text:
Platinum Price in 1994
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1994, the LBMA platinum price rose 8.8% between 1994-01-31 ($385) and 1994-12-29 ($419). The highest sampled price was $420 in October and the lowest was $385 in January. The mean of these observations was $408. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
